title: Account Policy
content:
# NovaMart Account & Security FAQ
Version: 3.0 | Effective: 2026-08-05 | Owner: Account Security

title: Account Policy
content:
## Password Reset
Customers can initiate a password reset using their registered email address. Reset links are confidential and should not be forwarded.

title: Account Policy
content:
## Locked Account
An account may be temporarily locked after repeated unsuccessful authentication attempts. Use the approved account recovery procedure rather than bypassing security controls.

title: Account Policy
content:
## Suspicious Login
For an unfamiliar login, recommend changing the password through the official recovery flow and reviewing recent account activity. Escalate suspected compromise to Account Security.

title: Account Policy
content:
## Personal Information
Never request passwords, authentication codes, full payment card numbers, or unnecessary secrets through support chat.

title: Account Policy
content:
## Identity Verification
Additional verification may be required before changing sensitive account information. Follow the approved verification procedure.

title: Payments Policy
content:
# NovaMart Payments & Billing Support
Version: 2.7 | Effective: 2026-07-20 | Owner: Payments Operations

title: Payments Policy
content:
## Failed Payment
A failed payment does not necessarily mean an order was created. Verify order state and payment status before asking the customer to retry.

title: Payments Policy
content:
## Duplicate Charge
When two charges are reported, determine whether one is only a temporary authorization. If both transactions were captured, Payments should review the duplicate for reversal or refund.

title: Payments Policy
content:
## Pending Authorization
A pending card authorization may disappear automatically if the transaction is not captured. Do not promise an exact release time because it depends on the payment provider.

title: Payments Policy
content:
## Refund Not Received
For an approved refund, verify the refund transaction and processing date. If the internal processing window has passed and the financial institution has not received the credit, escalate to Payments.

title: Payments Policy
content:
## Security
Never ask for a full card number, CVV, password, or one-time authentication code.

title: Refund Policy
content:
# NovaMart Refund & Return Policy
Version: 3.2 | Effective: 2026-08-01 | Owner: Customer Operations

title: Refund Policy
content:
## Standard Refund Eligibility
Customers may request a refund within 30 calendar days of delivery for eligible physical products. Products should normally be unused and returned with original packaging and included accessories.

title: Refund Policy
content:
## Damaged or Incorrect Items
If an item arrives damaged, defective, or materially different from the order, report the issue within 7 days of delivery. Customer Operations may request photographs or other evidence before approving a replacement or refund.

title: Refund Policy
content:
## Refund Processing
After an approved return is received and inspected, the refund is normally initiated within 5 business days. The bank or card provider may require additional time before the credit appears.

title: Refund Policy
content:
## Exceptions
Digital products are non-refundable after download or activation except where required by applicable law. Gift cards are non-refundable except where required by applicable law.

title: Refund Policy
content:
## Escalation
If a refund was approved but has not appeared after the stated processing period plus normal banking delay, escalate to Payments.

title: Shipping Policy
content:
# NovaMart Shipping & Delivery Policy
Version: 4.1 | Effective: 2026-08-15 | Owner: Fulfillment Operations

title: Shipping Policy
content:
## Standard Delivery
Standard domestic delivery is normally 3–7 business days after dispatch. The checkout date is an estimate, not a guaranteed delivery date.

title: Shipping Policy
content:
## Delayed Packages
If tracking has not updated for 72 hours, verify the carrier status. If the package is still moving, provide the latest estimated delivery information.

title: Shipping Policy
content:
## Lost Packages
Treat a package as potentially lost when the carrier reports it lost or its investigation threshold has been reached. Do not promise a refund before the required investigation is complete.

title: Shipping Policy
content:
## Incorrect Address
If an order has not shipped, Operations may be able to update the address. After carrier handoff, changes depend on carrier capabilities.

title: Shipping Policy
content:
## Damaged Delivery
Customers should report visible shipping damage as soon as possible, preferably within 7 days, with photographs when available.

title: Subscription Policy
content:
# NovaMart Subscription & Cancellation Policy
Version: 2.4 | Effective: 2026-09-01 | Owner: Subscription Operations

title: Subscription Policy
content:
## Cancellation
Customers can request cancellation at any time. Unless plan terms state otherwise, cancellation stops the next renewal but does not automatically refund a period already started.

title: Subscription Policy
content:
## Renewal
Renewals are charged according to the plan billing interval. Customers should review the renewal date displayed in their account.

title: Subscription Policy
content:
## Accidental Renewal
For an unexpected renewal, verify the transaction and applicable plan terms before promising a refund. Eligible exceptions should be reviewed by Subscription Operations.

title: Subscription Policy
content:
## Plan Changes
Upgrades or downgrades may take effect immediately or at the next billing cycle depending on the plan. Verify the current plan before describing the financial effect.

title: Subscription Policy
content:
## Escalation
Billing disputes involving subscription renewals should be escalated when the applicable plan terms do not clearly determine the outcome.

title: Warranty Policy
content:
# NovaMart Product Warranty Policy
Version: 1.9 | Effective: 2026-06-10 | Owner: Product Support

title: Warranty Policy
content:
## Warranty Coverage
Eligible products include a limited warranty against manufacturing defects for the period specified on the product page or warranty record.

title: Warranty Policy
content:
## Exclusions
Normal wear, accidental damage, misuse, unauthorized modification, and damage caused by incompatible accessories may be excluded.

title: Warranty Policy
content:
## Warranty Claim
Customers should provide the order number and a description of the problem. Photos or diagnostic information may be requested when appropriate.

title: Warranty Policy
content:
## Replacement or Repair
After eligibility is confirmed, Product Support determines whether repair, replacement, or another approved remedy is appropriate.

title: Warranty Policy
content:
## Escalation
If warranty eligibility is unclear or the product page and warranty record disagree, do not make a definitive promise. Escalate the case for review.
